items.title: 'This was not an exceptional result': Strategist talks AMD earnings & 'shocking' capex
items.summary: AMD (AMD) reported second quarter results on Tuesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $1.66 (compared to analyst estimates of $1.62), and revenue came in at $11.54 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $11.31 billion).Futurum chief market strategist Shay Boloor shares his thoughts with Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton.

items.title: AMD beats on Q2 earnings estimates, but also reports massive capex spend
items.summary: AMD (AMD) reported second quarter results on Tuesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $1.66 (compared to analyst estimates of $1.62), and revenue came in at $11.54 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $11.31 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the breaking numbers, including capex.

items.title: SpaceX's first earnings, AMD Q2 results, JOLTS data: What to Watch
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come on Tuesday, August 4, including SpaceX's (SPCX) first-ever earnings report, while Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) also releases quarterly earnings, and fresh employment data comes out in the form of the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS).

items.title: Tech stocks rally to kick off August. Can chipmakers keep up with demand?
items.summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) surge ahead to close out the first trading day of August with daily gains, the Nasdaq Composite rising by 2.13%. Cboe senior vice president JJ Kinahan joins Josh Lipton to assess the day's rise in the tech sector as key chipmakers like AMD (AMD) prepare to release earnings this week. Kinahan is also Cboe's head of retail expansion and alternative investment products.

items.title: AMD Earnings Beat Estimates and Stock Falls 8%: Was the Bar Too High?
items.summary: AMD earnings beat on revenue, profit, and margin, and guidance hit $13 billion. The stock still fell 8% after hours.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: S&P 500 Jumps To High; SpaceX, AMD Lead Earnings Movers Late
items.summary: The Dow and S&P 500 hit new highs while the Nasdaq powered higher again. SpaceX, AMD and Arista led earnings movers late.

items.title: AMD Q2 2026 earnings: record revenue as data center sales double
items.summary: Data center segment revenue climbed to $6.7 billion in the second quarter, up 107% from a year earlier, driving total revenue to $11.5 billion
